methodology.what_this_is: Advertised coaching rates from Coach-Halo coach profiles
methodology.dedupe: One price per coach per specialty
methodology.packages: 16 coaches list a coaching program/package format, but package prices are not stored as a separate field — not benchmarked.

specialties.label: Advertised coaching rates
specialties.currency_note: Currency is not stored as a field; values are treated as USD as entered.
specialties.session_length_note: Prices are per session as entered by coaches. Duration is unknown, so rates are not normalized to 60 minutes.
specialties.source: Coach-Halo coach profiles (Airtable Price per Session)
